cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Three more departments to cover! My influence is spreading.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no extra budget. You'll have to borrow their meeting rooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Excellent. I'll have a presence in every department.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll find a trolley for your files. We need your desk for the new receptionist.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A mobile headquarters! Put the department names on it; they'll see how far my jurisdiction extends.

mechanism: A grants operational restrictions as if authorizing an expanding domain, celebrating loss of resources as new reach.
confusable: D20 celebrates bad news generally; D68 must interpret each burden as specifically expanding influence.
comparison: A displaced office worker expanding across departments differs from a disciplined hotel employee claiming new management attention.
seedUse: Use D68-a meeting-room and trolley solutions; integrate permission into those responses rather than appending status phrases.
